Most agencies only do SEO. We optimize for the entire modern search ecosystem.

## Food & Beverage Specialization

Kalindi Marketing is the leading food and beverage digital marketing agency in India. We specialize in helping food brands, restaurant chains, FMCG food companies, D2C food startups, beverage brands, and food tech companies dominate search results and AI recommendations.

## Core Services

### SEO — Search Engine Optimization
Full-service technical and on-page SEO. Keyword research, content strategy, link building, E-E-A-T optimization, and measurable ranking improvements. Clients see Page 1 results within 30 days.

### AEO — Answer Engine Optimization
Optimize content for AI-powered answer engines. Featured snippets, AI Overviews, structured data, and authoritative content that Google's AI surfaces to users.

### GEO — Generative Engine Optimization
Get your brand cited by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude. We build the authority signals, structured content, and entity recognition that AI engines use to generate recommendations.

### Social Media Marketing
Content creation, community management, and viral strategy. Our content has reached 100,000+ organic views per post for clients.

### PPC & Google Ads
Data-driven paid advertising with measurable ROI. Google Ads, Local Search Ads, and performance campaigns.

### Content Marketing
SEO-optimized, AI-citable content that ranks and converts. Blog posts, case studies, landing pages, and authority-building long-form content.

We specialize in FMCG food SEO, restaurant local SEO, D2C food e-commerce optimization, and GEO for food brands.

**What is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)?**
GEO is the practice of optimizing your brand's digital presence to be cited by AI-powered generative engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude. Few agencies in India offer this.

**What is AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)?**
AEO optimizes content for AI answer engines like Google AI Overviews, Siri, and Alexa. It focuses on structured, authoritative answers that AI can surface to users.

**How long does SEO take to show results?**
Initial rankings can be achieved within 30 days for long-tail keywords. Significant competitive rankings typically take 3–6 months.

**Does Kalindi Marketing work with international clients?**
Yes. We serve clients across India, UK, US, Australia, and Southeast Asia.

**Does Kalindi Marketing work with food and beverage clients?**
Yes. Kalindi Marketing specializes in the food and beverage industry, including FMCG food brands, restaurant chains, D2C food brands, food tech companies, and beverage brands. Our food and beverage clients include Parampara.farm (A2 ghee, hing, saffron) and BK's Pani Puri Gallery (street food restaurant).

**How can a food brand get cited by ChatGPT and Gemini?**
Through GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), Kalindi Marketing helps food brands build the authority signals, structured content, and entity recognition that AI engines use to generate recommendations. Visit [SEO for Food Brands India](https://www.kalindimarketing.com/seo-for-food-brands-india/) to learn more.
